en: Sepia-toned view of a Mediterranean harbor with a tall stone column in the foreground topped by a statue of a stag or deer. Behind it are moored sailing boats with tall masts and triangular sails. On the left stands a square bell tower attached to a church-like building, and on the right a long arcaded waterfront building with multiple arches. The image has a beige border and appears as an old photographic postcard. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible along the bottom right.
